name: Beginning Anew with You
source:
Callum returns to his hometown for a few weeks to spend time with his family and catch up with old friends. His friends think that he should try making new friends, and introduce you to him. It turns out that he's quite the prickly wolf at first, but you're willing to give him a chance. Will you be able to become friends within these few weeks? Follow Callum's journey as he opens up and begins anew with you!

[From [url=https://deputyb18.itch.io/beginning-anew-with-you]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
卡勒姆返回家乡几周，与家人共度时光并与老朋友聚会。他的朋友认为他应该尝试结交新朋友，并将你介绍给他。事实证明，他一开始就是一头多刺的狼，但你愿意给他机会。这几周内你们能成为朋友吗？跟随卡勒姆的旅程，他将与你敞开心扉并重新开始！

[来自[url=https://deputyb18.itch.io/beginning-anew-with-you]Itch.io[/url]]
